scientific_question: Do segregating investment genotypes under actual visitor history remain in the source monomorphic β−/Γseed+ N6–9 window long enough to make a population-persistence effect plausible, and do the actual mixed-genotype source gradients agree with the monomorphic threshold?
study_scope: Recompute EXACT same 384 original source-pilot paths; no new visitor seeds, founder genomes, conditions, K, budget, policies, or stochastic replications. Derived mechanism trace, not a test of a new confirmatory endpoint.

dynamic_conflict.static_reference_only: Monomorphic original source focal β<−.02 and group Γ_seed>+.02 occurs for N6–9 with four fixed visitor types and resident [.2,.35,.35] at B48. Do not assign these monomorphic signs to actual populations as facts.
dynamic_conflict.actual_mixed_population_reproduction: At each native-genotype-expression pre-reproductive census with N6–9, compute group Gamma_seed using source Model3 finite simultaneous ±.005 investment expression perturbation; compute each of N focal plant's finite log(.5 F+.5 P+S) derivative by moving that individual to focal index0 and applying central ±.005 source reproduction. These are *within-state instantaneous contrasts*, not invasion gradients or realized allele changes.
dynamic_conflict.actual_conflict_definition: Gamma_seed>+.02 and at least half of original living N focal individuals have β<−.02 (exclude unresolved slopes from denominator only if explicitly reported; here fraction counts all N).
track: N for every pre-reproduction year t0..t79 (0 after extinction)
all policy t20 and t80 alive, first extinction, original t1 genotype SHA
pre/post investment allele mean conditional on occupied only
number of model years with N6–9 under each arm
consecutive years in N6–9 and first exit via N<=5 or N>=10
under native original parentage, mixed-genotype actual β-negative focal count, Γseed sign, and net nonfocal maternal seed benefit when N6–9
at each N6–9 year actual visitor functional richness, never claim visitor recruitment caused by plant investment
dynamic_conflict.source_holdout_guard: All output primary comparisons exploratory and no CI/p value or selective sample-size change. Preserve all original 384 source paths, including extinctions.

verification.whole_original_pilot_result_parity: Each path t1 SHA, census t20/t80, first_extinction and survivor allele mean must match uploaded original pilot ZIP digest, with current repo receipt source counts as a secondary guard.
verification.source_reproduction_and_population: Use unchanged Model3 reproduce_kb, population.advance, future visitors and demographic_streams from original archived pilot. Diagnostic ledger calls must NEVER consume RNG or affect next state.
verification.no_pseudoreplication: 80 years in one path, multiple plants in a year, and the two policies are repeated observations of one visitor-history unit.
verification.max_compute: Only per-focal gradients for source census N6–9 (otherwise record census; do not claim all-N actual gradient classification).
verification.model_ecology: Fixed four initial synthetic types; no natural islands or independent pollinator observations.

scientific_stop_rule: Do not launch a confirmatory 512-history effect search if >0 native paths fail original replay parity or if original source conflict occupancy lives mostly outside actual mixed-genotype conflict; report failure, occupancy floors/ceilings and unresolved mechanics.
